b1.text: someone just told you your app is slow.

b2.text: you open it... <break time="0.4s" /> loads in a blink. <break time="0.4s" /> so you blame their wifi. don't. <break time="0.5s" /> you built that app with Claude Code, you tested it, it was fast. <break time="0.35s" /> for you.

b3.text: your page loaded a thousand times today. <break time="0.4s" /> nine hundred came back in a tenth of a second. <break time="0.4s" /> twenty of them took nine full seconds. <break time="0.5s" /> and the average says four thirty. <break time="0.4s" /> fine. nothing to fix.

b4.text: there's a number that catches them.

b5.text: it's called latency percentiles. <break time="0.4s" /> p fifty is you. <break time="0.35s" /> p ninety nine is the person about to quit your app.

b6.text: one line to Claude: <break time="0.3s" /> time every request, show me p fifty, p ninety five, and p ninety nine. <break time="0.4s" /> not the average.

b7.text: that's the skill. <break time="0.4s" /> knowing what to ask for.
